properties.name: Casa Azul Villas
properties.description: A quiet boutique cluster of whitewashed Portuguese-style villas in the Assagao hills, 10 minutes by car from Anjuna and Vagator beaches. Built for privacy: villas are walled, most have their own pool, and there is no shared pool deck. Small all-day café; no bar.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 7 days before check-in. Cancellations within 7 days are charged 50% of the stay. No-shows are charged in full.
policies.children: Children of all ages are welcome. Children count towards villa occupancy. Pools are unfenced, so children must be supervised at all times.
policies.pets: Dogs are allowed in pool villas only, with prior approval. Not allowed in Garden Suites.
policies.smoking: Smoking is allowed in outdoor areas only.
policies.payment: 25% advance to confirm, balance payable at check-in. UPI, cards and bank transfer accepted.

addons.name: Airport transfer (Mopa or Dabolim)
addons.description: Private sedan, one way, up to 3 guests with luggage.

addons.name: Breakfast
addons.description: Goan-Continental breakfast served in your villa or at the café.

addons.name: Private chef dinner
addons.description: A chef cooks a 4-course Goan dinner in your villa. Price covers up to 6 guests.

addons.name: Late check-out till 16:00
addons.description: Subject to the villa not being booked that evening; confirmed 24 hours before check-out.

room_types.name: Garden Suite

room_types.name: Two-Bedroom Pool Villa
room_types.description: A walled villa with a king bedroom and a twin bedroom, a living room, a kitchenette and a 9 m private pool.

room_types.name: Three-Bedroom Pool Villa
room_types.description: The largest villa: two king bedrooms and one twin bedroom, a living and dining room, a full kitchen and a 12 m private pool.

properties.name: Tide & Tamarind Beach Resort
properties.description: A lively 80-room beachfront resort on Candolim beach with a large lagoon pool, a beach bar and a kids' play area. Walking distance to Calangute's restaurants and nightlife.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in. After that, the first night is charged.
policies.children: Children under 6 stay free using existing bedding. Children 6 and above count as extra guests.
policies.smoking: Non-smoking rooms. Smoking is permitted in the designated area near the beach bar.
policies.payment: Pay at the hotel. A card is required to guarantee the reservation.

addons.name: Airport transfer (Mopa or Dabolim)
addons.description: Shared resort shuttle, one way. Departs on fixed hourly slots.

addons.name: Breakfast buffet

addons.name: Mandovi sunset cruise

addons.name: Early check-in from 08:00

room_types.name: Deluxe Room
room_types.description: A 28 m² room with one queen bed facing the gardens. Strictly 2 guests; no extra beds.

room_types.name: Sea View Room
room_types.description: A 34 m² room with one king bed, a day-bed for a third guest and a balcony facing the sea.

room_types.name: Family Suite
room_types.description: Two connected rooms: one with a king bed and one with two twin beds, plus a small sitting area.

properties.name: Sossego Retreat
properties.description: A slow-paced eco retreat of wooden cottages on the quiet Agonda beach in South Goa. Daily sunrise yoga, an organic café and no loud music after 22:00. There is no common swimming pool.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 14 days before check-in. Within 14 days the booking is non-refundable.
policies.children: Children above 8 years are welcome. The retreat is not suitable for younger children.
policies.smoking: Smoking is not permitted anywhere on the property, including the beach front.
policies.payment: Full prepayment at the time of booking.

addons.name: Organic breakfast
addons.description: Fresh fruit, eggs to order and local bread at the café.

addons.name: Private yoga session
addons.description: A 75-minute one-to-one session with the resident teacher.

addons.description: Guaranteed cottage from 09:00 on arrival day.

room_types.name: Beach Cottage
room_types.description: A wooden cottage on stilts with one queen bed, an outdoor shower and a veranda looking at the sea. 2 guests only.

room_types.name: Plunge Pool Cottage
room_types.description: A secluded cottage set back from the beach with one king bed, a sofa-bed and a small private plunge pool.

properties.name: Jharokha Haveli
properties.description: A restored 18th-century haveli on the banks of Lake Pichola, a short walk from the City Palace. Narrow stairways (no lift), hand-painted rooms and a rooftop restaurant with lake views.

policies.cancellation: Non-refundable within 14 days of check-in. Earlier cancellations are refunded minus a ₹1,000 processing fee.
policies.children: Children are welcome. The haveli has steep stairs and open terraces, so it is not recommended for toddlers.
policies.pets: Pets are not allowed in the haveli.
policies.smoking: The haveli is entirely non-smoking to protect the original frescoes.
policies.payment: First night charged at booking, balance payable at check-in.

addons.name: Lake Pichola boat ride
addons.description: A one-hour sunset boat ride from the haveli's private ghat.

addons.name: Candle-lit rooftop dinner
addons.description: A private table for two on the rooftop with a set Rajasthani menu and lake views. Popular for anniversaries.

addons.name: Airport transfer (Maharana Pratap Airport)
addons.description: Private car, one way, about 40 minutes.

addons.name: Rooftop breakfast
addons.description: Indian and Continental breakfast on the rooftop.

room_types.name: Heritage Room
room_types.description: A compact hand-painted room with one queen bed and a courtyard window. 2 guests only.

room_types.name: Jharokha Lake Suite
room_types.description: A suite with one king bed, a carved jharokha window seat overlooking Lake Pichola and a clawfoot bathtub. A floor mattress can be added for a third guest.

policies.children: Children under 5 stay free. Children 5 and above count as extra guests.
policies.pets: Small pets under 10 kg are allowed in Premier Rooms on request.
policies.smoking: Non-smoking rooms. Smoking is allowed on balconies.
policies.payment: Pay at the hotel or prepay online.

room_types.name: Royal Lake Suite

properties.name: Pine Crest Cottages
properties.description: Family-run wooden cottages in an apple orchard above Old Manali, a 10-minute walk from the cafés of Manu Temple Road. Evening bonfires in the orchard.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 5 days before check-in. Within 5 days, 50% of the stay is charged.
policies.children: Children of all ages are welcome. Cots are available free of charge.
policies.pets: Well-behaved dogs are welcome in Family Cottages. Please tell us in advance.
policies.smoking: No smoking indoors. Smoking is allowed in the orchard away from the cottages.
policies.payment: 30% advance by UPI or bank transfer, balance at check-in.

addons.name: Private bonfire evening
addons.description: A reserved bonfire spot with snacks and hot chocolate for your group.

properties.description: A resort on the left bank of the Beas with snow-peak views, an indoor swimming pool, a spa and a kids' play room. The indoor pool is open 07:00-20:00.

policies.smoking: Non-smoking resort. Smoking is allowed in the garden gazebo only.
policies.payment: Pay at the hotel. A card is required to guarantee the reservation.

properties.name: Kettuvallam Houseboats
properties.description: Private overnight houseboats on the Alleppey backwaters, each with its own crew and cook. All meals on board are included. The boat cruises until 17:30, then anchors for the night. Mobile signal is patchy and there is no Wi-Fi on board.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 10 days before check-in. Within 10 days, 50% is charged.
policies.check_in_out: Boarding at 12:00 at Punnamada jetty, disembarking at 09:00 the next day.
policies.children: Children are welcome. Life jackets for children are provided on board.
policies.pets: Pets are not allowed on the houseboats.
policies.smoking: Smoking is allowed on the open upper deck only.
policies.payment: 50% advance to confirm, balance payable on boarding.

addons.name: Village canoe tour
addons.description: A 2-hour country-boat ride through narrow canals to a coir-making village.

addons.name: Airport transfer (Kochi)

room_types.name: Two-Bedroom Houseboat
